title.en: Why You Get Sleepy When You Do

desc.zh: 困意来自醒着越久越高的睡眠压力，和一只每天被光拨准的体内钟。九个可以拖动的模型：熬夜和通宵、暗室里的钟、光的相位响应曲线、时型、时差、周末和夜班、咖啡因。
desc.en: Sleepiness comes from a sleep pressure that builds while you are awake and a body clock that light resets every day. Nine models you can drag: late nights and all-nighters, the clock in a dark room, the light phase-response curve, chronotype, jet lag, weekends and night shifts, caffeine.

desc.zh: 醒着时睡眠压力按指数朝上限爬升，睡着时按指数回落；长期少睡时它停在一个更高的位置。
desc.en: Sleep pressure climbs exponentially toward a ceiling while awake and decays while asleep; with chronic short sleep it settles at a higher level.

en: why do I get tired the longer I'm awake

desc.zh: 睡眠压力碰到随昼夜节律起伏的入睡线就睡着，降到醒来线就醒；节律把睡眠锁在 24 小时。
desc.en: Sleep starts when pressure hits an upper threshold that rises and falls with the circadian rhythm and ends at a lower one; the rhythm locks sleep to 24 hours.

zh: 为什么每天同一时间犯困
en: why do I get sleepy at the same time every day

title.en: Late nights, naps and recovery sleep

desc.zh: 晚睡的人不一定多睡；通宵后的补觉只比平常多一点；熬夜最难受的时刻在清晨。
desc.en: Going to bed late does not mean sleeping longer; recovery sleep after an all-nighter is only a little longer; the worst moment of a late night is the early morning.

zh: 为什么熬到天亮反而不困
en: why can't I sleep in after a late night

title.zh: 体内钟的周期与自由运行

desc.zh: 人的体内钟平均约 24.2 小时；在暗室里没有光去拨它，它每天晚一点。
desc.en: The human clock averages about 24.2 hours; in the dark it runs a little later every day.

desc.zh: 体温最低点之前的光把钟推后，之后的光把钟提前，模型曲线与人体测量对照。
desc.en: Light before the temperature minimum delays the clock and light after it advances it; the model curve is compared with human measurements.

zh: 晚上的光会推迟生物钟吗
en: does evening light delay the body clock
how light resets the circadian clock

title.zh: 同步与时型：早鸟和夜猫子

desc.zh: 钟停在哪里取决于它的周期和白天、晚上的光：周期长、晚上亮、白天暗，人就成了夜猫子。
desc.en: Where the clock settles depends on its period and on daytime and evening light: a longer period, bright evenings and dim days make a night owl.

en: why am I a night owl

desc.zh: 飞越时区后体内钟每天只追上一截；实测向西每天约 92 分钟、向东约 57 分钟，模型中东西快慢取决于周期。
desc.en: After crossing time zones the clock catches up a little each day; measured about 92 min/day westward and 57 min/day eastward, while in the model which way is faster depends on the period.

zh: 为什么往东飞时差更难倒
en: how long does jet lag last

title.en: Social jet lag and night shifts

desc.zh: 闹钟截短工作日的觉，周末补回来；夜班工人的钟翻不翻过来，取决于上班和下班路上的光。
desc.en: Alarms cut workday sleep short and weekends make it up; whether a night worker's clock flips depends on light at work and on the way home.

zh: 为什么周一早上特别难起

desc.zh: 咖啡因挡住腺苷信号而不清掉睡眠压力；下午一杯到睡前还剩多少，取决于因人而异的半衰期。
desc.en: Caffeine blocks the adenosine signal rather than clearing sleep pressure; how much of an afternoon cup is left at bedtime depends on a half-life that varies widely.

zh: 下午喝咖啡影响睡眠吗
en: why does coffee keep me awake
